newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Nov mth/mth inflation seen at 1.3/1.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Nov mth/mth inflation seen at 1.3/1.8 pct.

text.p: Estonia's finance ministry said on Wednesday said it expected month-on-month inflation in November to be between 1.3 and 1.8 percent.
Although final inflation data will be released by the statistics office early next month, the finance ministry said in a statement it had its own calculations on price rise forecasts.
It said food prices were expected to rise most in November at 2.5 to three percent, and manufactured goods by one to 1.5 percent but service prices would remain stable.
October monthly inflation was 0.6 percent and year-on-year inflation 17.2 percent.
